description: A 20-stage bucket brigade of sample and hold latches, moving every held value one stage along on each clock pulse.

inputs.text: A rising edge here samples the signal input and shifts every held value one stage along; unpatched, that happens once per engine sample, making a delay of a few samples.
The signal sampled on each clock pulse.

outputs.text: The value the signal input held that many clock pulses ago, kept steady until the next pulse.

menu: Randomize — sets every bucket to a random value inside the digital voltage range.
Digital Voltage Range — a submenu of 0-1V, 0-5V, 0-10V, -5V to 5V and -10V to 10V, setting the pair of voltages used for low and high; an input reads high above the midpoint of the pair.
Visuals — a submenu of Blue, Dark and Light for the colour scheme, plus Flat for a look without the 3D shading. The choice covers every SubmarineFree module and is kept outside the patch.
